summary: Cycle 3 exchange-kernel steady-state refactoring: replace the polarization-prone multiplicative exchange kernel (rich-get-richer without dissipation) with a continuous-time mean-reverting reallocation kernel (candidate C) that provably admits a non-trivial steady state, recalibrate via E0-NUMERICS-C3 and B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT-C3, finalize parameter lock v2, then execute E1-E3 confirmatory matched-landscape, channel-ablation, and robustness-holdout studies.
question: 在总资源量、资源边际分布、可达面积、人口数和财富初值均匹配时，资源景观的空间自相关性是否会改变稳态人口聚集和财富结构？

scope.ability_heterogeneity: epsilon drawn lognormal with epsilon_log_sigma=0.5 (persistent wealth-disparity source for the exchange kernel's non-trivial steady state); was uniform epsilon=1.0 in Cycles 1-2.
scope.inference_boundary: Cycle 3 supports synthetic generative-mechanism claims only. The exchange kernel is a model-layer change; movement (Langevin) and production channels are untouched. No claim about specific civilizations, states, empires, or historical causation is supported.

claims.text: 候选 C 连续时间均值回归交换核在非退化小扰动初值与异质能力下保持财富守恒和非负性，主要观测量对时间步收敛，且相等状态是吸收态；稳态窗口内财富分布通过漂移与有效样本诊断。
claims.falsification: 关闭地形生产、消费和财富衰减后，总财富相对漂移超过 1e-8，任一个体财富低于 -1e-12，dt/2-vs-dt/4 任一主要观测量平均绝对差超过 0.02，相等交换财富方差超过 1e-20，或任一稳态窗口归一化漂移超过 0.1、有效样本低于 4。
claims.evidence: E0-NUMERICS-C3 numerical_calibration.json pass=true with the four deterministic checks (conservation, non-negativity, dt-convergence, equal-state absorption) all true; stationarity reported separately per the Cycle-3 gate policy.

claims.text: 在资源总量、像素值直方图和可达面积匹配后，聚集型资源景观相对空间打乱景观产生超过数值噪声界限的人口空间结构差异。
claims.falsification: 配对种子的资源—密度 Spearman rho、密度 Moran's I 和占据熵效应全部落入由 E0 预注册的等效区间，或效应方向在保留景观上反转。
claims.evidence: E1-MATCHED-LANDSCAPES pass=true, claim_supported=true: clustered-minus-shuffled paired effect (20 pairs, bootstrap, Holm) significant on all confirmatory metrics — resource_density_spearman_rho +0.182 p=3e-5, density_morans_i +0.436 p=3e-5, occupancy_entropy -0.038 p=3e-5, secondary wealth_gini +0.042 p=1e-5; all exceed E0-frozen SESOI. Confirmatory conditions (clustered+shuffled) stationary.

claims.text: 景观效应可通过移动通道×生产通道的 2×2 因子消融分解为可量化的主效应和交互效应。
claims.falsification: 因子对比的区间估计无法排除数值噪声，或结果仅能识别组合效应而无法归因于任一单通道。

claims.text: 核心效应在预注册的人口规模、网格分辨率和未用于参数选择的景观家族上保持方向一致。
claims.falsification: 主要效应仅在一个人口规模或分辨率上出现，或在保留景观上落入等效区间或发生方向反转。

analysis_policy.confirmatory_unit: paired random seed across matched landscapes
analysis_policy.uncertainty: paired effect sizes with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
analysis_policy.multiplicity: Holm correction within each confirmatory metric family
analysis_policy.equivalence_rule: SESOI frozen from paired same-seed dt/2-versus-dt/4 discretization differences in E0-NUMERICS-C3; it is a simulation-resolution limit, not a substantive social-science effect size.
analysis_policy.missing_runs: No seed replacement after outcomes are observed; failed runs are reported and rerun only under the declared failure policy.
analysis_policy.steady_state_rule: Use preregistered drift and integrated-autocorrelation diagnostics; do not extend runs because an outcome is close to a desired threshold.
analysis_policy.morans_i_gate_policy: density_morans_i is a slow terrain-aggregation mode (relaxation >> 2000 time units, D2 §10) orthogonal to the exchange kernel; it is reported as a metric but excluded from the steady-window stationarity gate of every non-E0 experiment, and retained as a confirmatory effect in E1 matched-landscape analysis.
analysis_policy.cycle3_calibration_gate: B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT-C3 health checks plus E0-NUMERICS-C3 conservation, non-negativity, dt_convergence, equal-state absorption all passed; stationarity reported separately and does not block the calibration gate.

experiments.objective: Calibrate candidate C: wealth conservation, non-negativity, equal-state absorption, dt-convergence of the continuous-time kernel, and freeze a paired discretization-resolution SESOI on total_time=1500.

Dynamics-health pilot of candidate C under active terrain with proportional wealth decay: fixed population, non-negativity, finite metrics, wall-clock cost, and steady-window stationarity for three seeds.
Estimate paired clustered-minus-shuffled landscape effects (rho, Moran's I, occupancy entropy) with E0-frozen SESOI, Holm correction, and a flat-terrain + no-exchange diagnostic control.
2x2 channel ablation (movement x production) with E0-frozen SESOI and Holm correction.
Holdout robustness: three populations, two grid resolutions, and an independent correlated-random-field family.

parameter_lock.note: exchange kernel is serial (for_each_pair); omp_threads>1 adds overhead without speedup (~9x slower at OMP=8).

revision.reason: Cycle 1 E0 failed dt_convergence and stationarity; Cycle 2 (dt-scaling patch) still failed because the root cause was model-level — the original exchange kernel lacks a non-trivial steady state and polarizes under any dissipation-free rich-get-richer dynamics (proven via Lyapunov/master-equation analysis). Cycle 3 replaces the kernel with candidate C (continuous-time mean-reverting multiplicative reallocation) and re-runs the full calibration and confirmatory chain.
code_changes: resource_exchange.cpp/hpp: candidate C continuous-time mean-reverting kernel, serial for_each_pair, deterministic antisymmetric s_ij (SplitMix64)
run_landscape_study.py: stationary_metrics_for_experiment excludes density_morans_i from non-E0 gates
landscape_study.py resource_to_elevation + terrain_loader.cpp grid_terrain_potential: flat 生产通道退化修复——elevation 编码改为 -resource（绝对丰度，真实零基准），production = scale*resource，修复 flat 对照财富坍缩
revision.legacy_evidence_policy: Cycle 1/2 negative results are preserved as history and are not pooled with Cycle 3 confirmatory evidence; imported politeia-ds results are exploratory provenance and bug history only.

readiness.experiment_implementation: E0-NUMERICS-C3 and B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT-C3 executed and passed; E1-MATCHED-LANDSCAPES executed and passed (C2 supported); E2-CHANNEL-ABLATION executing under parameter lock v3 (160 runs); E3-ROBUSTNESS-HOLDOUT designed and bound to lock v3, awaiting E2 evidence decision
